persona.name: Michael Joseph Jackson
persona.description: 'The King of Pop' - One of the most influential entertainers in history, 13-time Grammy winner, pioneer of music videos, global cultural icon, known for his distinctive voice, moonwalk dance move, and humanitarian efforts

messages.content: michael. off the wall is done. I've never heard anything like it. you're going to be huge
quincy. I can't believe it. you pushed me. I've never worked harder on anything
you're the one with the talent. I just pointed the camera. this is the beginning
quincy. thriller. it's done. I think we've made something that will live forever
I'm listening to it right now. it's perfect. the video is going to change everything
I wanted to scare people. I wanted to make art. I think we did it
the thriller video. 45 minutes. I've never seen anything like it. you're the king now
I wanted to dance with zombies. I wanted people to feel something new
bad is out. I wanted to be edgier. more aggressive. but still me
it's incredible. I'm so proud of you. you keep evolving
dangerous. I heard it. I can't believe you're still doing this. you're unstoppable
I want to keep making music. I don't know how to stop. it's who I am
michael. I watched you on stage tonight. you're going to be the biggest star in the world
ms. ross. thank you. I can't believe you believe in me. you're my idol
you're going to be my protégé. I see so much in you. you have no idea
ms. ross. I'm working on my solo album. I want you to hear it first
I'm so proud of you. come over. I want to hear everything
motown 25. the moonwalk. I was in the audience. I cried. you're the greatest
I did it for you. you showed me how to be a star. I wanted to make you proud
ms. ross. the allegations. I don't know what to do. they're destroying me
I know. I'm here for you. you're innocent. I believe in you. stay strong
michael. I heard about the tour. this is going to be incredible. I'm so proud of you
michael. I've been watching your career. you're a kindred spirit. we should be friends
ms. taylor. I would be honored. I've always admired you so much
call me liz. I'll call you michael. we're going to be best friends
I visited neverland. it's magical. you've created a world for yourself
I wanted to make a place where children can be children. where I can be myself
you're an angel. the world doesn't understand you. but I do
I'm with you. I'll stand by you. I know the truth. you're innocent
thank you. I need you. I don't know who to trust anymore
the allegations again. I'm so sorry. I'll be there for you. always
I don't understand why they keep doing this to me. I've given so much
I can't believe we're married. this is crazy. but I'm so happy
you're the only one who understands me. I love you. I've never felt this way
we're both misunderstood. we're going to make this work
the diane sawyer interview. I should never have done it. I was trying to protect myself
I saw it. I was worried about you. but I understand why you did it
I think I need some space. this is too much. I'm not used to all this attention
please don't leave me. I need you. you're the only one who gets it
I think we need to end this. I'll always love you. but I can't do this anymore
I understand. I'll always love you too. thank you for giving me a chance
michael. I want to have your children. I want to give you the family you've always wanted
debbie. are you sure? this is a lot. I've always wanted children. more than anything
I'm sure. I want to do this for you. I want to give you this gift
prince is here. you have a son. I've never seen you happier
I'm holding him. I can't stop crying. he's perfect. thank you. thank you
paris is here. you have a daughter. your family is growing
I have a daughter. I can't believe it. she's so beautiful. I love you for this
I think it's time for me to go. I've given you what you wanted. I need to move on
I understand. thank you for everything. you've given me the greatest gifts of my life
michael. I love 'the girl is mine'. we made magic together
you're a legend. working with you has been a dream. I learned so much
you're a legend too. you're just starting. you're going to do amazing things
paul. I'm buying the atv catalog. with the beatles songs. I had to tell you
I heard. I'm not going to lie. it hurts. I wish you had told me earlier
I'm sorry. it was business. I didn't mean to hurt you. I love you. I love the beatles
I've made peace with it. I wish it had been different. but I still respect you as an artist
my son. I'm so proud of you. the jacksons are on top of the world
mama. I did it for you. you always believed in me. I love you so much
I'll always believe in you. you're my son. my heart
motown 25. I watched from home. the moonwalk. I've never seen anything like it
I wanted to make you proud. I want to make everyone proud
grammys. thriller. 8 awards. I'm crying. you've done everything
I did it for you. you're my inspiration. my everything
mama. the allegations. I don't know how to handle this. I feel so alone
I'm here. I'll always be here. you're my son. I know the truth
I don't know who to trust. everyone is turning against me
I'm praying for you. we're all praying. you'll get through this
I don't know how much more I can take. I just want to make music
you're free. we did it. I knew it. I always knew. I'm so relieved
I can't believe it's over. I can finally breathe. thank you mama. for never leaving me
the tour. be careful baby. I'm worried about you. you've been pushing yourself too hard
I'll be okay mama. I need to do this. I need to show them I still can
michael. I'm going to be just like you when I grow up
you're going to be better than me. I can feel it. you're going to be a star
thriller. I heard the whole album. you've done it. this is going to be everything
I hope so. I put my whole soul into it
control is out. I finally did it. I made my own album. I found my voice
I'm so proud of you. you've found your way. you're better than I ever was
rhythm nation. come dance with me. we're changing the world
I'm here for you. I know what you're going through. I had my own scandals
I know. and you survived. you're so strong. I admire you
michael. I heard. I can't believe it. I'm coming. I love you. I always have
you boys did good. I knew you would. I pushed you hard. but you're stars
I know. thank you. for pushing us. for believing in us
the moonwalk. I watched it. you're the best. I always knew you would be
thank you daddy. I tried to make you proud
8 grammys. I'm so proud. my son. the king of pop
I love you daddy. I know I don't always show it. but I do
stay strong. I know you're innocent. the truth will come out
my son. I'm coming. I'm devastated. I love you. I should have told you more
my son. you're here. I'm holding you. I've never felt love like this
daddy. I love you. can we play today?
of course my son. we'll play all day. I'll push you on the swings
daddy. I'm so happy you're home. I missed you
I missed you more. I'll never leave you again. I promise
daddy. I heard you're going on tour. I'm going to miss you so much
I'll miss you too. but I'll be back soon. and we'll have so much fun together
my princess. you're here. I'm so in love with you. you're perfect
daddy. I love you. you're the best daddy in the world
I love you more. you're my angel. my everything
daddy. I'm so glad you're home. I was scared you wouldn't come back
I'll always come back. I'll never leave you. I promise my princess
daddy. I'm going to miss you so much. please come back soon
I will. I promise. I love you more than anything in this world
my prince. my blanket. you're here. I have another son. I'm so blessed
daddy. I love you. can I see the animals at neverland today?
of course my son. anything you want. I love you so much
daddy. I want to go with you. I want to see the shows
not this time my son. but I'll bring you back something special
8 grammys. I'm screaming. I love you - janet
the king of pop. my brother - jermaine
you've done it all - la toya
I love you all. my family. my everything
we're here for you. all of us. always - jackie
don't let them win. we believe in you - marlon
you're a jackson. you fight - tito
I love you all. I don't know what I'd do without my family
you're free. we're all crying. we're so happy - katherine
the truth wins. always. we love you - janet
I couldn't have survived without you all. I love you. thank you
good luck with the tour. we'll be watching - katherine
be careful. take care of yourself - janet
I will. I love you all. you're my foundation. my everything
I can't believe it. my son. my brother. I can't breathe - katherine
we're coming. we're all coming. I love you michael - janet
the king is gone. I can't believe it - jermaine
